name: v8-r3-aim-gain
description: Cell R-3 (plan section 9, N 43): persistence gain on the aim (S-2 option A): g_k = theta sum_j (1 - theta)^j rho_k(j) from rank autocorrelation only, theta .05, clipped to [.05, 1] as coded (fit_composition_weights.py ew-theme-aim-v1). The change as coded: fit --composition ew-theme-aim-v1; downstream outputs renamed (fit, card, w, nav, monitor); the u pass is the parent's. Acceptance: dSR > 0 AND mechanics AND net Sharpe at 2x NAV not lower (capacity curve, carried from B0c) AND turnover lower.
requires: composition on top of the parent's: the registration applies the aim gains on top of the R-1 weights, but as coded ew-theme-aim-v1 scales the ew-theme-v1 weights (no composable std + aim rule; test_aim_gain_composes_with_theme_std is unwritten). Remove this entry when the parent's fit uses --composition ew-theme-v1 (R-1 rejected) or once a composable rule exists and its flag is set here.
